question: Which of the following rivers has been mentioned as ‘Vitasta’ in Vedic literature?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Jhelum.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Vedic name of Jhelum is Vitasta.**
 
• The Vitasta is referred as one of the **crucial rivers by the holy scriptures, the Rigveda.**
 
• The Jhelum is the important **waterway of the Kashmir valley**.
 
• The Jhelum River is a river in the **northern Indian subcontinent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rigvedic hymns mention many rivers' names different from modern ones.
